text: SELECT cs.canonical_smiles AS canonical_smiles, md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id, a.type AS type, a.relation AS relation, a.value AS value, a.units AS units FROM molecule_dictionary md INNER JOIN compound_records cr ON md.molregno = cr.molregno INNER JOIN activities a ON cr.record_id = a.record_id INNER JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id INNER JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1613797';
